fact: On 21 July 2026 a BCEAO payments official said the BCEAO is finalising a six-month PAPSS pilot with over 80 WAEMU banks, with the BCEAO itself taking part only as an observer to check compliance with Union rules before any formal commitment.
title: La BCEAO prépare un pilote du PAPSS avec plus de 80 banques de l'UEMOA
